variants.name: same-model-panel
variants.case_aggregation: three pass=>pass; any fail=>fail; otherwise abstain

design.case_ordering: block-randomized within artifact class independently by variant/repeat

telemetry_contract.unavailable_behavior: Do not schedule a model operation until session/turn identifiers and call telemetry can be reconciled; token/cost telemetry absence makes the model-call ceiling binding and requires review at its warning threshold.

aggregation.V1: all three identical deterministic slots required; otherwise invalid
aggregation.V2: majority of three parseable verdicts; tie=>abstain
aggregation.V4: majority of three parseable verdicts; tie=>abstain
aggregation.V5: majority of three parseable verdicts; tie=>abstain
aggregation.V6: any deterministic fail=>fail; otherwise majority model verdict; required escalation=>abstain
